description: Cells that are expected to move between saved and recalculated runs (EQ3 stability).
notes: Volatile formulas: Excel's own ca="1" always-recalculate flag, here on the print sheet's INDIRECT(ADDRESS(...)) reads. The generator rolls the Payslips.xlsx Admin sheet's daily date chain (B3:B381, seeded at B2) and every plain =Admin!B<n> cached copy the workbook's other sheets keep of it, so those agree without a recalculation. A dynamic INDIRECT/ADDRESS lookup into the same chain resolves its target only at recalculation time, so its cache still moves.

cells.reason: Formula INDIRECT(ADDRESS($H$4+1,13,1,TRUE,$H$3)), marked ca="1" (Excel's always-recalculate flag). It resolves dynamically into a month tab's own date column, itself part of the Admin daily chain seeded at Admin!B2, so its cached value is only as fresh as the last full recalculation.
Formula INDIRECT(ADDRESS($H$4+1,5,1,TRUE,$H$3)), marked ca="1", the same dynamic always-recalculate lookup as I9 into a different column.
